# Research Development Fund (RDF) and Department Development Fund (DDF) rules {#sec:rdfddf}

The Institute incentivizes faculty to pursue extramural R&D funding by
ploughing a portion (15% at the time of writing) of the overheads from
sponsored projects back into the Principal Investigators' Research
Development Fund (RDF); unspent funds in private industry funded
projects or consulting projects may also be moved into the RDF account
at the time of closing, with the requisite approvals. Thus, there is
an RDF account for every faculty member in the IRCC website (Drona),
which practically runs like an open-ended project account. Details are
available [here](https://rndhelp.ircc.iitb.ac.in/faculty/rdf). The
Institute deposits ₹ 1,00,000 each year into each faculty's RDF
account. The money in your RDF can be used for attending conferences,
paying for publishing charges, patenting charges, purchase of laptops,
etc.

::: {.review}
**Updates from 2025–26 circulars**

- IRITPP has been merged with RDF. IRCC maintains a document listing the
  activities and purchases that are allowed (and some that are not)
  through RDF.
- Items that border on personal use must be accompanied by a note from
  the PI on the purpose of the purchase and its relevance to the
  project/lab, forwarded through the HoD of the project department to
  the Dean (R&D), using IRCC's "Justification Template for Borderline
  Personal Items". The PI should give details such as location of use
  and the overall guest list (for meals). IRCC Accounts processes the
  bill after the Dean (R&D)'s approval. The same procedure applies to
  consultancy and government-sponsored projects.
- Faculty members can buy headphones/AirPods through RDF once in 3
  years.
- The RDF project end date is set at the faculty member's
  superannuation date. On superannuation, IRCC closes the RDF after
  deducting IRCC expenses/contribution, and any unspent balance is
  transferred 50% to DDF and 50% to IRCC.
- Exceptional procurement for project-related expenses from RDF needs
  the approval of the HoD and the Dean (R&D).

*Sources:* emails from the Dean (R&D) Office to faculty-notices,
14.08.2025: ["Utilization of
RDF"](https://rndhelp.ircc.iitb.ac.in/ircc-notifications/faculty-notices/2025-08-14-115400/utilization-rdf)
and ["Procedure for purchase of items bordering personal
use"](https://rndhelp.ircc.iitb.ac.in/ircc-notifications/faculty-notices/2025-08-14-104000/procedure-purchase-items-bordering-personal-use-through-consultancy-projects-rdf-and-government-sponsored-projects);
email from the Office of the Dean (R&D), 09.05.2026, "Implementation of
Revised Guidelines for Project Management (w.e.f. 15.04.2026)".
:::

IRCC ploughs back another percentage (again, 15% at the time of
writing) of the overheads from sponsored projects back into a
Departmental Development Fund (DDF). The funds therein are intended to
be utilized by the Head of the academic unit for departmental needs, usually in the nature
of Consumables, Maintenance, and Travel – these could range from
teaching lab consumables and maintenance to student conference travel
support.
